name: active season is snout_season_1, stored end 2026-11-09 00:15 UTC (20261029260000; the flip at 00:00 pulls it back)
sql: select s.id, s.ends_at = '2026-11-09 00:15:00+00'::timestamptz as ends_at_known_cutoff from public.active_season() s

name: Season 2 is dark: snout_season_2 starts in 2099, season2_flipped false
sql: select to_char(s.starts_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY') as starts_year, (select c.enabled from public.app_config c where c.key = 'season2_flipped') as season2_flipped from public.seasons s where s.id = 'snout_season_2'

name: the halloween_2026 stall is closed (opens_at IS NULL)
sql: select key, opens_at from public.seasonal_shelves where key = 'halloween_2026'

name: 35 new-lane accessory/background rows and 11 costume rows
sql: select (select count(*) from public.hats where shelf_lane = 'new' and category <> 'costume') as new_lane_non_costume, (select count(*) from public.hats where category = 'costume') as costume_rows

name: no new-lane piece or costume in daily_shop() (today's drop, and the filter itself)
sql: select (select count(*) from public.daily_shop() d where d.shelf_lane = 'new' or d.category = 'costume') as in_todays_drop, position('shelf_lane IS DISTINCT FROM ''new''' in pg_get_functiondef('public.daily_shop()'::regprocedure)) > 0 as filter_excludes_new_lane

name: trader_tuning: pair_multiplier 1.5, trade_up true, finds_per_visit 9
sql: select value -> 'pair_multiplier' as pair_multiplier, value -> 'trade_up' as trade_up, value -> 'finds_per_visit' as finds_per_visit from public.app_settings where key = 'trader_tuning'

name: min_build is inert (build 0)
sql: select value -> 'build' as build from public.app_settings where key = 'min_build'

name: every local migration is applied except the three held ones
sql: select version from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations order by version

name: season-end jobs armed once each: season2-flip (0 0 9 11 *) and great-hunger-reminder (0 0 8 11 *)
sql: select count(*) filter (where jobname='season2-flip' and schedule='0 0 9 11 *') = 1 and count(*) filter (where jobname='great-hunger-reminder' and schedule='0 0 8 11 *') = 1 as ok from cron.job

name: the founder's preview override is the only shelf_preview in production
sql: select count(*) = 1 and bool_and(username = 'Brian' and discriminator = '4075' and is_test) as ok from public.profiles where feature_overrides ? 'shelf_preview'
